Task instance batch number of the instance generated
Task code of the task which refers to this variable
Instance code of the task instance which refers to this variable

Business time of the task instance.Business time is defined as the starting time of the task's frequency cycle.    If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM    For daily task the business time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00    For weekly task the business time is the Monday 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-05-31 00:00:00    For monthly task, the business time is 0AM of 1st day of the month of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-01 00:00:00    For hourly task, the business time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
Date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210603
Previous month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202105
Previous date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210531
Previous hour of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMddhh, e.g. 2021053109
Year of the current task instance business time, format yyyy, e.g. 2020
Month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202005
Date of the current task instance business time, format dd, e.g. 30
Hour of the current task instance business time , format hh, eg: 18

The time of a day a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched. If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the scheduled time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the schedule time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd. The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.

The time of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met. If the start run time is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the start run time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the start run time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.

content:
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Author:              wei.tao@shopee.com
-- Created Time:        2026-02-03
-- Description:         用户行为主题域，Risk ToC主题
-- Data Granularity:    shopeepay user id 
-- PRD:                 
------------------------------------------------------------------------


-- drop table if exists ${SCHEMA}.dws_risk_${region}_user_behavior_spp_frequency_device_df;
create table if not exists ${SCHEMA}.dws_risk_${region}_user_behavior_spp_frequency_device_df
(
    shopeepay_user_id string comment 'shopeepay_user_id' ,
    spdf_list string comment 'spdf_list' ,
    szdf_list string comment 'szdf_list' 
) 
comment 'risk feature summary table'
partitioned by
(
    grass_date string comment 'grass_date, partition key'
)
stored as orc
tblproperties
(
    "orc.compress" = "zstd"
)
location '${HDFS_PATH}/risk_mart/dws/dws_risk_${region}_user_behavior_spp_frequency_device_df/grass_region=${grass_region}';
-- msck repair table ${SCHEMA}.dws_risk_${region}_user_behavior_spp_frequency_device_df;


add jar hdfs://R2/projects/credit/hdfs/udf/hive-udf.jar;
drop temporary function if exists format_time; 
create temporary function format_time as 'com.shopee.seamoney.udf.FromTimeStamp';


create or replace temporary view tmp_risk_strategy_final_result as
    select 
    a.flow_no
    ,a.platform_user_id
    ,a.shopeepay_user_id
    ,a.device_fingerprint
    ,a.req_time
    ,format_time(a.req_time,'${grass_region}') as req_time_local
    ,a.workflow_flow_no
    ,a.topic_name
    ,a.risk_scene_id
    ,get_json_object(extension, '$.CommonHeader.extension_process_data.sz_dfp.device_id') as szdf
    ,get_json_object(extension, '$.is_spl_activated')                                     as is_spl_activated
    ,get_json_object(extension, '$.is_cashloan_activated')                                as is_cashloan_activated
    ,'${grass_region}'                                                                                 as grass_region
from risk.dwd_risk_${region}_strategy_final_result_merge_di a 
join (
    select 
        topic_name
        ,scene_id
    from risk.dim_risk_af_pharse_topic 
    where grass_region = '${grass_region}'
    and tn_type='live'
    and is_fs_topic='1'
    group by 
        topic_name
        ,scene_id
)b on a.topic_name = b.topic_name and a.risk_scene_id = b.scene_id 
where grass_date>=date_sub('${grass_date}',190)
and grass_date<='${grass_date}'
-- and device_fingerprint is not null
-- and device_fingerprint <>''
-- and device_fingerprint <>' '
group by a.flow_no
        ,a.platform_user_id
        ,a.shopeepay_user_id
        ,a.device_fingerprint
        ,a.req_time
        ,format_time(a.req_time,'${grass_region}')
        ,a.workflow_flow_no
        ,a.topic_name
        ,a.risk_scene_id
        ,get_json_object(extension, '$.CommonHeader.extension_process_data.sz_dfp.device_id')
        ,get_json_object(extension, '$.is_spl_activated')
        ,get_json_object(extension, '$.is_cashloan_activated')
;

create or replace temporary view tmp_workflow_tab as
select 
    flow_no
    ,'${grass_region}' as grass_region
from  risk.dwd_risk_${region}_af_credit_workflow_di 
where grass_date >= date_sub('${grass_date}',190)
--and from_unixtime(create_time)>= date_sub('${grass_date}',190)
and run_step <>''
and run_step like '%pass%' -- so final result also passed or verify passed
group by  flow_no
;

with tmp1 as (
    select 
        cast(t1.shopeepay_user_id as string) as shopeepay_user_id
        ,case when t1.shopeepay_user_id is not null and t1.spdf_list <> '[]' then regexp_replace(regexp_replace(t1.spdf_list,',]',']'),'\\[,','[')
            else null end                       as spdf_list
        ,case when t1.shopeepay_user_id is not null and t1.szdf_list <> '[]' then regexp_replace(regexp_replace(t1.szdf_list,',]',']'),'\\[,','[')
            else null end                       as szdf_list
    from (
        select 
            shopeepay_user_id
            ,regexp_replace(array_distinct(collect_list(device_fingerprint)),'"','') as spdf_list
            ,regexp_replace(array_distinct(collect_list(szdf)),'"','')               as szdf_list
            ,grass_region                                                            as grass_region
            ,'${grass_date}'                                                         as grass_date
        from (
            select 
                a.shopeepay_user_id
                ,a.device_fingerprint
                ,a.szdf
                ,case when a.topic_name like '%_live_credit_risk_gateway_req_rsp_kredit' and risk_scene_id='10013' and a.is_spl_activated = '1' then 0
                    when a.topic_name like '%_live_credit_risk_gateway_req_rsp_spj' and risk_scene_id='10013' and a.is_cashloan_activated = '1' then 0
                    else 1 end as is_available
                ,a.grass_region
            from tmp_risk_strategy_final_result a 
            join tmp_workflow_tab b on a.workflow_flow_no= b.flow_no and a.grass_region = b.grass_region
            where to_date(a.req_time_local)>= date_sub('${grass_date}',181)
        ) a 
        where is_available=1
        group by shopeepay_user_id,grass_region
    ) t1
)

insert overwrite table ${SCHEMA}.dws_risk_${region}_user_behavior_spp_frequency_device_df partition (grass_date = '${grass_date}')
select 
    a.shopeepay_user_id as shopeepay_user_id
    ,tmp1.spdf_list
    ,tmp1.szdf_list
from (
    select cast(shopeepay_user_id as string) as shopeepay_user_id
    from shopeepay.mart_dwd_us_user_account_tab_ds__${region}
    where grass_date = '${grass_date}'
) as a
left join tmp1 on a.shopeepay_user_id = tmp1.shopeepay_user_id
;
